about:
Belmont Market has operated in Wakefield, Rhode Island since 1947. The business describes itself as family-owned, with the tagline "fresh from our family to yours" reflecting its multi-generational roots. No individual founders are named in the available information.

The market runs a full-service grocery operation that includes deli, floral, grocery, health and wellness, meat, prepared foods, produce, seafood, and sushi departments. In addition to retail sales, it offers event catering, gift basket assembly, an online shopping platform with home delivery across Washington County and Jamestown, and curbside pickup. The company also maintains a wholesale division and a vendor inquiry program for suppliers.

Its primary customer base is local consumers seeking everyday groceries, prepared meals, and specialty items such as sushi and gift baskets. The wholesale channel and vendor inquiry page indicate it also serves other businesses, including local producers and food-service accounts, though specific client names are not disclosed.

Belmont Market emphasizes its commitment to local sourcing, stating it "keeps a focus on local where we can" and works to make shopping local easy for customers. The family-owned heritage and chef-prepared meals are presented as core differentiators.
